activity_summary: At the Theatre the plot was The Shrew, this day, at two of the clock. Your side was an old man's. There was no name of a part on the peg worth taking home to the letter.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Played the side, and left it unnamed.

entities.name: The Shrew
entities.context: Mentioned in The side on the peg

facets.activity: Took an old man's side in The Shrew
